$Comment: The stagger: a short stun that never cuts a full stun short. Its ZigEffectFamily tag puts it in the Stunned effect family beside Zig_Stunned (a Parent's tags are its child's too; it is written here as well so a same-id restyle keeps it in mind). Everything else comes from Zig_Stunned, so restyle that file, or ship one with this id to make staggers look different.
